design: Five newly composed scenes, original scenery/backgrounds; no original level grid copied
collision_policy: Native placement phases and lower-band footprints for small props; explicitly authored structural supports. Sprite rectangles are never automatically made solid.

levels.name: 01 - Market Day Detour
levels.instructions: Tour the pens around the tractor and buildings. The central yard and southern road form bypasses; leave the beer for Lars.

levels.name: 02 - Bales, Bones and Back Doors
levels.instructions: Use the back doors between rail pens. The dog guards the east pen, but a bone and two puddles give you escape routes.

levels.name: 03 - Three Islands and a Picnic
levels.instructions: Cross wooden bridges between three new islands. The southern picnic island is a side trip; puddles rescue a swim and offer optional shortcuts.

levels.name: 04 - The Sleepy Forester Trail
levels.instructions: Follow the S-shaped clearing between dense groves. Stumps split the trail, Lars and Bromse patrol the eastern forks, and smell/flowers change your animal strategy.

levels.name: 05 - The Rose Protocol
levels.instructions: Steal the rose protocol through crate banks, glowing consoles and a central brain machine. Two aliens guard the laboratories; an artifact and rocket open a fast final circuit.
